## [1.2.0] - 2024-03-15

### Added
- Real-time parking spot availability updates
- Push notifications for reservation reminders
- Multi-factor authentication support
- Export functionality for reports

### Changed
- Improved search algorithm for faster results
- Updated payment gateway integration
- Enhanced mobile responsive design

### Fixed
- Fixed issue with concurrent reservation conflicts
- Resolved payment timeout problems
- Fixed email template rendering issues

### Security
- Updated dependency versions for security patches
- Enhanced session management

### Changed
- Optimized database queries
- Improved error handling

### Fixed
- Fixed login timeout issues
- Resolved calendar display bugs
